Shipping policy

Orders placed before two in the afternoon on a working day are dispatched the same day from the nearest fulfilment centre that holds the item in stock. Orders placed after that cutoff, or on a Sunday or public holiday, are dispatched on the next working day. Delivery to metropolitan addresses normally takes two working days from dispatch and delivery to other addresses takes three to five working days depending on the courier network serving that pin code.

Bulky items such as furniture and large appliances are moved by a separate freight partner and are scheduled by telephone before delivery, because someone must be present to accept the consignment and check it for transit damage before signing. If nobody is available at the agreed time the consignment returns to the depot and a second attempt is scheduled at no extra charge. A third attempt is charged at the standard freight rate for the route.

Damaged consignments must be reported within forty eight hours of delivery with photographs of the packaging and the item, otherwise the freight partner will not accept the claim.
